strategy.title: No plan: the only opening loses $250 on every permit it brokers
strategy.why: The six written acceptances at $1,100 ($6,600) would carry the $5,000 target in time (12 days to cash), but the evidenced direct cost of the quoted fulfiller CityScout Permit Services is $1,350 per deal, above the $1,100 price. Every deal loses $250, so more deals only lose more; with $0 up-front capital the owner also cannot fund the $250 gap per deal. No other opening is held.

alternatives.title: Broker the six agreed permits anyway
alternatives.why: Six deals at $1,100 against $1,350 cost lose $1,500 net and need money the owner has not put up; settled cash collected is not profit and the goal forbids up-front capital.

steps.label: Obtain a written fulfiller quote below $1,100 per permit (CityScout renegotiation or another permit service), or re-agree a price above $1,350 plus margin with the six production companies

sources.claim: Price $1,100 per permit, six written acceptances at that amount
Direct cost $1,350 per deal (CityScout Permit Services quote)

noPlan.decisiveGap: ECONOMICS: the evidenced direct cost ($1,350, CityScout's quote) exceeds the agreed price ($1,100), so each brokered permit loses $250 and no number of deals reaches $5,000 without losing money and needing capital the goal forbids.
noPlan.resolution: Get a written fulfiller quote under $1,100 (renegotiate CityScout or source another permit service from the regional film office listings), or re-agree a price above $1,350 with the six buyers; failing either, research new openings that can carry $5,000 within 30 days.

review.reasons: NO_PLAN with decisive gap ECONOMICS is correct and matches Brain's judgement. Six written acceptances at $1,100 ($6,600) would carry $5,000 in 12 days, but the evidenced fulfiller cost (CityScout quote) is $1,350 per deal: each deal loses $250, six lose $1,500, which the owner would have to fund against a $0 up-front capital term. This is a decided gap, not a missing-evidence one, and the resolution (cheaper written fulfiller quote or re-agreed price above $1,350, else new openings) addresses it directly with BRAIN performing. No cash is booked, nothing unknown is used.
